items.problem: `withdraw` stops only when a `remove_user` is `'FAILED'`, and `RemoveUserModule.remove_user` is typed `'FAILED' \| null \| undefined` (server/core/auth/deps.ts:190), so `CHANGED` of `chat`, `friend`, `guild` is not handled. open-game-works-core/skills/server-core/modules/auth.md:175 and :352 require a `CHANGED` `remove_user` to stop the later operations and end `Withdraw`/`ConfirmAge` with `INTERNAL`, rolled back, with an `error` log that `auth` leaves (auth.md:476). Once friend returns `CHANGED` as R3-1 requires, `Withdraw` would go on to `guild`, `block-report`, `request_analytics_deletion` and `storage.delete_user` while friend deleted nothing, leaving link rows and counts of the withdrawn user. No server core module returns `CHANGED` yet (`grep "CHANGED'" server/core` finds none)
